changes: Built the native Windows executable from the personal USA ISO at upstream 14e956a. The ISO hash is unchanged; generated game code, assets and binaries remain private.

Observed first-fight attacks and enemy reactions, death/Continue, pause/options controls and runtime snapshots loaded in new processes. Real memory-card save/load is still open; the fresh card correctly reports no game save.

Added a small original data-read extension only in a separate local GPL checkout. The first two reader hooks failed in the game; covering the actual EE HLE read path produced the external magenta ground.

Published both unchanged 800x600 control/replacement PNGs in the comparison gallery. Three unaffected facade regions match exactly; all changed pixels are in the visible ground band. Existing black margins are retained.

Recommend LasVola provisionally as the playable base, preferably through upstream work or a distinct GPL fork. Lucas provides matching-decompilation understanding, not an already reproduced PC port. The independent Rust lab stays preserved and paused.
updates.validation: Native build and bounded runtime trials completed. Same executable and local GPL revision d3a018a for both modification modes; 29,050 unchanged landmark pixels match exactly and 38,301 pixels change in the ground band. Installed helpers pass 561 original synthetic overlap cases plus configuration/file checks. 26 public journal/publication Python tests pass. No game pixels or game code are CI fixtures.
updates.limits: Same-size replacement only, not true HD texture support. No game save/load round trip, later-stage playthrough, audible audio or physical-device validation yet. Headless viewport margins remain unexplained. Lucas matching percentages are upstream reports; native Windows tests stop at 65 passes / 5 skips / 5 failures. Game imagery is not MIT; the private GPL extension is not imported here.
